import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

## Objective
- Build a browser hide-and-seek hunting game where an elf huntress seeks camouflage slimes in an elf village, using the user-provided elf character reference sheet.

## Requirements
- User language: Korean; UI should be in Korean.
- Story: slimes sneak into an elf village; elf hunts them.
- Elf character must be modeled after the provided reference images: blonde high ponytail, pointed ears, green leaf outfit, brown leather bracers/belt, quiver, bow.
- Slimes must change color to match their surroundings; elf must find and shoot them.
- Must support Android/iOS phones/tablets with responsive layouts, touch controls, and safe areas.

## Decisions
- Self-contained static HTML/Three.js project, no build step; Three.js r170 vendored locally.
- Procedural low-poly/cel-shaded art: custom elf model, village environment, slimes, particles, and WebAudio SFX; no external textures/models.
- Gameplay: third-person fixed-yaw camera, WASD/joystick movement, pointer/touch aiming, ballistic arrows, 8 slimes, 165-second round, focus mode (Shift / hold button) reveals hidden slime outlines.
- Slimes camouflage to exact ground-patch colors, with subtle gloss/ripples/peeking as fair clues; flee if player gets close or arrow lands nearby.
- Fonts: Jua + Gowun Dodum downloaded locally into `assets/fonts/` with `fonts.css`.
- Verified environment: Playwright/Chromium + SwiftShader available; server must run on port 3002 per project instructions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Downloaded and inspected all three reference images (character turnaround + walk sheets).
- Vendored `three.module.js`, downloaded 182 Korean webfont subsets into `assets/fonts/`, generated root `fonts.css`.
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and all JS modules: `utils.js`, `textures.js`, `world.js`, `elf.js`, `slimes.js`, `particles.js`, `arrows.js`, `audio.js`, `ui.js`, `main.js`.
- Implemented title screen, HUD, pause/result overlays, mobile joystick/focus button, story text, score/combo/timer/detection systems, intro toasts, win/lose flow.
- Implemented elf model (hair, ponytail, ears, face, leaf dress, pauldron, bracers, quiver, recurve bow/string, sandals), procedural walk/aim/draw animations.
- Implemented village world: plaza, well, pond, huts, garden, sign, target, trees/grass/flowers/rocks, hide-spot decals and props, lighting/day-dusk progression.

### Active
- Debug pass on the code before first browser run; several visual/geometry bugs were just fixed, one `edit` failed and still needs applying.
- Not yet served, loaded, screenshotted, or tested in a browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Apply failed fix in `src/main.js` `endGame()`: add `document.body.classList.remove('focus-on');` before `focusHeld = false;` (exact nearby lines 641–643).
2. Apply pending world fixes: move water hide spot/puddle from `(-8.3,-2.6)` (inside pond collider) to ~`(-7.0,-2.8)` and update its patch/reeds coords.
3. Apply pending geometry fixes in `world.js`:
   - Remove grass/bush spots inside plaza: `[-2,4.9]`, `[4,-3.3]`, `[-3.4,-2.5]`; move `[6.4,8.9]` away from flower spot; move rock `[16.5,7.8]` (overlaps `pale` hide spot).
   - Remove `rz` double-rotation from all `inc.logs` entries (geo already rotated Z by PI/2).
   - Remove `fencePostGeo.translate(0,0.5,0)` so posts aren't floating.
   - Set `y:0` for tufts/reeds/mushroom stems; fix flower field stem `y/sy`; set lilies `sy:1`, stone slabs `sy:1`; raise moss caps to ~`0.86*s`.
   - Change hide-spot patch material from `alphaMap: patchTex` to `map: patchTex` for soft edges.
4. Add `rank-D` CSS styling (`.result-seal.rank-D`).
5. Add color-space/tone-mapping includes to sky ShaderMaterial in `world.js`.
6. Fix particle `gl_PointSize` formula in `src/particles.js` from `size * (260.0 / -mv.z)` to roughly `size * (10.0 / -mv.z)` (current particles will be enormous); optionally add pixel-ratio uniform.
7. Remove `ringDot.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2` in `src/main.js` (double rotation makes dot face downward).
8. In `src/slimes.js`: call `this.closeEyes()` in constructor; clear old ripple meshes in `SlimeField.reset()`.
9. Start server via tmux: `PORT=3002 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"`; verify with `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`, inspect console, screenshot title and gameplay desktop/mobile.
10. Tune visuals/gameplay from screenshots, capture final desktop + mobile screenshots, confirm no console errors and acceptable performance.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game loop, state machine, input, camera, aim/shoot, start/pause/result flow, debug `window.__game`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: village environment, hide spots, colliders, lighting/day cycle; contains most pending geometry fixes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/elf.js`: procedural elf archer model and animation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/slimes.js`: slime camouflage AI, flee/peek/catch logic, hit tests.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all UI markup and title/result screens.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full responsive UI styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: HUD/overlay/DOM updates.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/arrows.js`: ballistic arrows, trajectory preview helper.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/particles.js`: splat/sparkle particle pools; point-size bug.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio music/SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: procedural canvas textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/fonts.css` + `assets/fonts/`: locally hosted Korean fonts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: vendored Three.js r170.
- `/tmp/opencode/refs/elf1.png`, `elf2.png`, `elf3.png`: downloaded user reference images.

## Important Context
- Project is a plain static HTML site (no `package.json`); default runtime serves repo root on `PORT`.
- The default capture script auto-clicks a button whose `aria-label` is exactly `Play`; the start button already has `aria-label="Play"`.
- `main.js` top-level awaits `document.fonts.ready` before building the world/UI.
- Debug API: `window.__game.start()`, `.quit()`, `.catchAll()`, `.setFocus(v)`, plus references to game/field/elf/world/camera/renderer/ui/player.
- Current git changes are all uncommitted; no commit/push has been made.
- Font download used `python3` (not fontTools) and placed 182 woff2 files; total ~2.5 MB.
- Screenshot/capture workflow should use `playwright-cli` and SwiftShader; report software rendering, not hardware acceleration.

## Objective
- Build a browser hide-and-seek hunting game where an elf huntress seeks camouflage slimes in an elf village, using the user-provided elf character reference sheet.

## Requirements
- User language: Korean; UI should be in Korean.
- Story: slimes sneak into an elf village; elf hunts them.
- Elf character must be modeled after the provided reference images: blonde high ponytail, pointed ears, green leaf outfit, brown leather bracers/belt, quiver, bow.
- Slimes must change color to match their surroundings; elf must find and shoot them.
- Must support Android/iOS phones/tablets with responsive layouts, touch controls, and safe areas.

## Decisions
- Self-contained static HTML/Three.js project, no build step; Three.js r170 vendored locally.
- Procedural low-poly/cel-shaded art: custom elf model, village environment, slimes, particles, and WebAudio SFX; no external textures/models.
- Gameplay: third-person fixed-yaw camera, WASD/joystick movement, pointer/touch aiming, ballistic arrows, 8 slimes, 165-second round, focus mode (Shift / hold button) reveals hidden slime outlines.
- Slimes camouflage to exact ground-patch colors, with subtle gloss/ripples/peeking as fair clues; flee if player gets close or arrow lands nearby.
- Fonts: Jua + Gowun Dodum downloaded locally into `assets/fonts/` with `fonts.css`.
- Static server runs on port 3002; visual verification uses Playwright + SwiftShader (software rendering).

## Work State
### Completed
- All game modules, title/HUD/pause/result screens, Korean copy, desktop and touch controls implemented.
- Fixed `#app` scrolling bug using `overflow: clip` plus `scrollTop` resets in `startGame`/`quitToTitle`.
- Fixed title panel vertical centering with dedicated `titleRise`/`titleRiseLandscape` keyframes; added scroll-safe max-height and hidden scrollbar.
- Applied world geometry fixes: water spot moved to `(-6.3,-2.3)` with smaller puddle, removed plaza-overlapping bushes/rock, corrected log rotations, grounded tufts/reeds/mushrooms/fence posts, corrected flower stems/lilies/stone slabs, raised moss caps, switched hide patches to `map`.
- Added A/D rank styles, sky shader colorspace/tonemapping includes, particle point-size fix, correct ringDot orientation, slime `closeEyes()`/ripple reset.
- Reduced slime gloss/shine for better camouflage; enlarged aim preview dots.
- Verified desktop title/gameplay, aiming/shooting (caught a slime, score 100), focus mode, pause, win S-rank and lose D-rank result screens, mobile portrait title/gameplay, joystick movement, touch shot, and touch focus.
- Console has 0 errors; remaining warnings are Three.js/WebGL performance messages.
- Browser verification required symlinking `chromium-1243` to installed `chromium-1248` under `~/.cache/ms-playwright`.

### Active
- Final visual/behavior tuning pass; last check showed a slime did not flee even when player stood ~1.1 units away (state remained `hidden`), so flee trigger may be too lax or blocked by state conditions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/slimes.js` update logic to verify player-proximity flee trigger (`startFlee`) and adjust distance/radius or cooldown so hidden slimes flee when the huntress gets close.
2. Re-verify flee visual/ripple and confirm no console errors.
3. Final cleanup: ensure touch-only instructions (`집중 버튼으로`) and hidden SHIFT label render correctly; remove temporary debug artifacts if desired.
4. Capture final desktop and mobile screenshots (title + gameplay + focus) and confirm the water puddle and slime camouflage look correct.
5. Optionally inspect/remove `window.__game` debug API or gate it behind a query parameter.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game loop, state machine, input, camera, aim/shoot, start/pause/result flow, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: village environment, hide spots, colliders, lighting/day cycle.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/elf.js`: procedural elf archer model and animation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/slimes.js`: slime camouflage AI, flee/peek/catch logic, hit tests.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all UI markup and title/result screens.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full responsive UI styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: HUD/overlay/DOM updates and input bindings.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/arrows.js`: ballistic arrows and trajectory preview.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/particles.js`: splat/sparkle particle pools.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio music/SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: procedural canvas textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/fonts.css` + `assets/fonts/`: locally hosted Korean fonts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: vendored Three.js r170.
- `/tmp/opencode/refs/elf1.png`, `elf2.png`, `elf3.png`: user reference images.

## Important Context
- All changes are uncommitted; no commit/push has been made.
- Project is a plain static site (no `package.json`); default runtime serves repo root on `PORT=3002`.
- Server is running in tmux session `game`; Playwright sessions are `game` (desktop 1050x793) and `touch` (iPhone 15 emulation).
- Default capture script auto-clicks a button whose `aria-label` is exactly `Play`.
- Character front-facing close-up requires manually setting `elf.root.rotation.y = atan2(camera.x-elf.x, camera.z-elf.z)` after freezing RAF, because title mode turns the elf toward the orbiting title camera.
- Under SwiftShader, frame rate is low and `dt` is capped at 0.05, so result transitions can take much longer than 1.35 real seconds; wait longer before checking result state.

import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }
